question: Should OpenClaw accept this stack's public includeFamily history selector plus default-off sessionFamilyCarryover prompt injection, and should it land together with or after #90239?
rationale: The code shape is bounded and tested, but the permanent API/config surface and archived-context provider boundary are maintainer product decisions, not mechanical repair choices.

options.title: Review and land the stack
options.body: Approve #90239 and this PR together or in order, keeping carryover default-off and requiring exact-head CI before merge.

options.title: Land lookup first
options.body: Merge #90239 as the explicit history retrieval layer first and defer prompt carryover until maintainers separately accept archived-context injection.

options.title: Reject prompt carryover
options.body: Close or substantially redesign this PR if maintainers do not want archived reset summaries injected into model prompts even behind an experimental opt-in.

recommendation.title: Review and land the stack
recommendation.body: Approve #90239 and this PR together or in order, keeping carryover default-off and requiring exact-head CI before merge.
